scope.description: An optional direction for a user-requested tabletop still life. Tilt the supporting plane toward the viewer enough to reveal its surface, then balance the requested objects across that plane through contact, overlap, and warm-cool color relationships. Objects may keep slightly different local axes, but they remain solid and connected to their support. Fruit, bottles, cloth, or a particular tabletop are not defaults.
limitations: Activate only for a user-requested still life with a visible table or counter.
Preserve all requested objects, counts, materials, and relationships; do not add a default fruit, bottle, cloth, or plate.
Tilt the support plane as a controlled local choice; do not warp every surface or make objects appear to fall.
Keep contact points and object weight readable even when local axes differ.
Text-only generation may create unstable gravity or table edges; review support and object contact.
Do not copy a named still life, its exact object arrangement, or distinctive props.

rules.applies_when: The user requests a tabletop still life and allows interpretive perspective.
rules.instruction: Tilt the visible tabletop or counter plane toward the viewer so its surface occupies a clear structural area; let one edge or cloth fold reveal that tilt without turning the entire room into a new viewpoint.
rules.observable: The viewer sees the tabletop surface and can read its changed angle from a visible edge, plane boundary, or fold.
rules.reject_when: The support becomes a vertical wall, the tilt is imperceptible, or background geometry shifts as strongly as the tabletop.
rules.avoid: full-scene fisheye distortion, overhead flat-lay, and copied table edge arrangement

rules.applies_when: The user requests multiple objects sharing one tabletop.
rules.instruction: Arrange the requested objects as a connected mass network using deliberate intervals and selective overlaps; give each object a stable base or contact relation on the tilted support and preserve its identity.
rules.observable: The objects feel related as a still life, remain individually countable, and appear supported rather than sliding or floating.
rules.reject_when: Contact points disappear, objects merge, or the still life becomes a scattered inventory with no shared balance.
rules.avoid: extra fruit, bottles, plates, or cloth unless requested; evenly spaced catalog rows

rules.applies_when: The user permits painterly perspective rather than strict product rendering.
rules.instruction: Let one or two requested object axes differ slightly from the support plane's angle; use adjacent warm and cool color planes and short directional strokes to keep each object solid despite the local mismatch.
rules.observable: The viewer notices a gentle perspective disagreement but still understands the object's volume, material, and support.
rules.reject_when: Every object's axis conflicts independently, the table and objects lose solidity, or smooth shading replaces constructive color.
rules.avoid: impossible geometry, global fragmentation, and airbrushed gradients
